name: Price discovery

subjectOf.text: Broker quotes are an unreliable fallback for valuation: they can be hard to obtain and can vary by 20 to 30 percent for instruments such as mortgage-backed securities, which makes accurate valuation of those securities difficult.
subjectOf.abstract: In addition, broker quotes may be difficult to obtain and can be quite unreliable—mortgage-backed securities, for example, can sometimes vary by 20 to 30 percent—making accurate valuation of these securities difficult.
subjectOf.citation: Kaal, Hedge Fund Valuation Retailization, Regulation, and Investor Suitability (2009). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=1428387
scope_conditions: where recent transaction prices and marketable bids and offers are not readily available

subjectOf.text: Stable cryptocurrency bonds should be minted with a fixed expiration, following the practice of historical central banks, because fixed expiration makes price discovery more efficient.
subjectOf.abstract: We also recommend following the example of historical central banks, in minting bonds with fixed expiration so price discovery is more efficient
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Vadhindran K. Rao, Stable Cryptocurrencies - First Order Principles (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3402701

subjectOf.text: Running an alternative trading system on a blockchain cures the ATS system's traditional price discovery latency, because every trade is posted to a public ledger that everyone can access.
subjectOf.abstract: By creating an ATS that trades securities over blockchain, there is no latency in price discovery, which has traditionally been a criticism of the ATS system. This is because every trade is posted to a public ledger to which everyone has access.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Samuel Evans, Blockchain-Based Securities Offerings (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3411110
scope_conditions: ATS operating on a public blockchain ledger

subjectOf.text: A blockchain based offering routed through a single broker produces a specific cluster of risks, including limited price discovery, no market making and therefore less liquidity, constrained short selling, impaired best execution, and no print to a tape or national exchange.
subjectOf.abstract: Several additional risks are associated with the limited trading and associated limited material liquidity that results from a blockchain-based offering involving only one broker.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Samuel Evans, Blockchain-Based Securities Offerings (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3411110
scope_conditions: offering structures with only one authorized broker-dealer

subjectOf.text: Concentration of power, especially monopolies or trusts, decreases market liquidity, while decentralization of power improves it.

subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralized Finance (DeFi) (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782216

subjectOf.text: Universal access combined with a public bidding price discovery methodology creates low barriers to entry in the code review market, because anyone can join the CRDAO by submitting high quality code reviews through the CRDAO portal.

This price transparency is unique and unprecedented in a market that is otherwise dominated by a cartel.

subjectOf.text: Flatter markets with more diverse interests and talents are more effective and efficient at truth discovery, including price discovery and the identification of ideal solutions to new problems, and decentralization promotes that diversity by improving member autonomy and freedom.
